test_case.test_name: Ten loaded AC drops at 40C/+5% rails
test_case.purpose: Prove a fully populated system under approved CPU/DIMM/storage load survives ten abrupt AC losses at margin, logs each event and recovers every device and protected data path.
required_package: Full device inventory and non-destructive stress targets
Approved AC-drop fixture/feed/off-on dwell and power-on policy
Expected power-loss log and per-cycle readiness/integrity oracle
Environment, OOB abort and restoration plan
test_case.test_command: Operator establishes full inventory, disposable storage target and calibrated margin. For each of ten ledger rows, reach the approved CPU/DIMM/HDD steady state for five minutes, timestamp abrupt AC removal, prove true-off dwell, restore AC, wait for BMC/OS readiness, enumerate devices, verify expected loss logs and filesystem/test-data integrity. Stop on any anomaly; after ten restore nominal environment and health.
test_case.expected_result: All ten loaded drops show the required steady state, true loss and clean recovery; expected AC-loss events are recorded, every device returns, disposable data/filesystem checks pass, no hang/BSOD or disallowed error occurs, and restoration succeeds.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: PASS requires ten complete loaded-drop transactions and per-cycle integrity/inventory proof. Normal shutdown, reboot, unloaded cycling, fewer drops, unsafe live-data writes, log clearing or automatic retry cannot pass.
safety_gate: Qualified power operator, approved fixture/feed and independent OOB
Storage load limited to disposable authorized target; protect OS/live data
Abort on corruption, overcurrent/thermal fault, boot failure or device loss
Preserve evidence; no retry; controlled restoration
expected_evidence: Expected power-loss logs and per-cycle inventory
test_case.recovery: On corruption, readiness, device or electrical fault, stop remaining drops, preserve the failed transaction, keep power in an approved safe state, use OOB/vendor recovery, restore nominal environment and never automatically repeat the drop.
